argv: F=/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin; tick=2026-10-14T20:00:34Z; for spec in "kumitate-shokunin 175de6ba" "kagi-shokunin fecee874" "tsukuroi-shokunin 72b038da" "mado-shokunin 12c8f08a"; do set -- $spec; g="git -C $F/$1"; l=$($g rev-parse --verify -q "$2^{commit}"); echo "== $1 recorded live-HEAD $l"; echo "   own date: $($g log -1 --date=iso-strict-local --format="%cd (author %ad) %s" $l | cut -c1-110)"; if $g merge-base --is-ancestor $l HEAD; then echo "   ancestor of current HEAD $($g rev-parse HEAD): yes"; else echo "   ancestor of current HEAD: NO"; fi; echo "   first descendants on ancestry path to HEAD:"; $g log --ancestry-path --reverse --date=iso-strict-local --format="     %H %cd %s" $l..HEAD | head -2 | cut -c1-130; echo "   commits (all refs) with committer date in (own, tick]:"; $g log --all --since="$($g log -1 --format=%cI $l)" --until=$tick --date=iso-strict-local --format="     %H %cd %s" | grep -v "^     $l" | head -5 | cut -c1-130; done
